partners.diseaseBName: encephalopathy, progressive, early-onset, with episodic rhabdomyolysis
partners.mechanism_chain: LMAN1 (HGNC:6589) —DISRUPTS→ ER-Golgi trafficking (GO:0006888); TRAPPC2L (HGNC:28334) —DISRUPTS→ ER-Golgi trafficking (GO:0006888); ER-Golgi trafficking (GO:0006888) —LEADS_TO→ Factor V deficiency (HP:0001916); ER-Golgi trafficking (GO:0006888) —LEADS_TO→ Factor VIII deficiency (HP:0001919); ER-Golgi trafficking (GO:0006888) —LEADS_TO→ Encephalopathy (HP:0001295); ER-Golgi trafficking (GO:0006888) —LEADS_TO→ Rhabdomyolysis (HP:0003130). Loss-of-function mutations in LMAN1 and TRAPPC2L disrupt the ER-Golgi trafficking pathway. This disruption impairs the proper secretion and function of Factor V and Factor VIII, leading to combined deficiency of type 1. Concurrently, the compromised ER-Golgi transport also affects the processing and delivery of proteins essential for neuronal and muscle function, resulting in encephalopathy and episodic rhabdomyolysis.
